reason: Fresh-main Final Capability Completeness / Release Readiness delta audit originally began on main@29c032d0216bf551519245c1d0bfe67273205f24 and remains content-equivalent after the recorded forward-only recovery pair now ending at main@62f3935605dac9ab96f76f80cee88943dfae1a2c. The audit proves a same-root post-retirement reachability gap. Yance already has authoritative local backup, verification, staged restore, encrypted portable .yancebackup export/import/verification/restore, retention and recovery services, and Electron file-dialog seams. A tray action still exposes quick backup, but the active Element Product has no data-protection/system-settings surface for backup verification, restore, portable import/export or restore-state visibility after #428 retired frontend/ as Product authority; those controls remain concentrated in retired frontend/r32-system-center.js. In the same root, tools/wp2/command-path-inventory.js still discovers renderer call locations only by walking retired frontend/, so executable command-path evidence can report legacy renderer reachability without proving the sole active Element Product. This is classified as a P1 release-readiness/data-recovery reachability candidate, not absence of backend backup authority. This revision is diagnostic-only: it authorizes one tests-only Fast Closure V2 path to capture all currently observable same-root boundaries before any production path is authorized. Cloud synchronization, public-release updater work, Learning authority expansion, system-DPI font automation, new channel expansion, formal SBOM/provenance distribution closure, Issue #1 real Windows UAT, release/publish, dependencies, workflows, database migrations and PR #538 are outside this diagnostic root.

mainRecoveryEvidence.reuseRule: All later work binds fresh main 62f3935605dac9ab96f76f80cee88943dfae1a2c; no force-push/rebase/amend may erase the recorded pair.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact normalized repository-relative paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

expectedFailures: The sole active Element Product has no user-reachable data-protection/system-settings surface for listing backups, verifying a backup, staging/cancelling restore, showing restore history, or creating/verifying/restoring encrypted portable backups even though the backend authorities already exist.

Portable backup file import/export Electron seams exist in preload/main but are not consumed by the active Element Product; retired frontend/r32-system-center.js remains the only substantial user-facing data-protection surface.

tools/wp2/command-path-inventory.js discovers renderer locations only under retired frontend/, so formal command-path evidence does not prove active Element Product reachability and can be satisfied by historical renderer calls.

requiredProofs: Trusted main is freshly read and equals base.commit before authorization merge.
Authorization proposal remains exactly one governance file.
Implementation branch starts exactly from the effective ordinary authorization merge.
Fresh trusted main still equals that exact authorization merge immediately before creating the immutable first tests-only implementation head.
The one-path diagnostic set/count/SHA-256 exactly matches this document and is recognized by base-owned delegated implementation policy.
Element ProductExperienceShell/YanceWorkspace remains the sole active Product renderer and frontend/ remains retired from Product authority.
Current backend/routes/system.js plus backupService/portableBackupService already provide real backup, verification and restore authority and must be preserved rather than reimplemented.
Electron preload/main already provide portable backup file-dialog custody while the active Element Product has no consumer for those seams.
tools/wp2/command-path-inventory.js currently walks frontend/ only for rendererLocations and therefore does not establish active Element reachability.
Tray quick backup, restart local service and open-data/open-logs entries are alternate reachable controls and must be classified as PRESERVE rather than duplicated.
No production path, dependency, workflow, routing policy, database migration, backend authority replacement or release/publish change is authorized by this revision.
